title: Project Profile (v1.2)
description: Procurement context, program classification, applicable regulations, known/unknown facts, material versions, and review scope for one tender review cycle.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier for this review cycle.

procurement_program.description: Classified procurement program type (e.g. public_tender, competitive_negotiation, etc.). Unknown → explicit 'unknown' value.

classification_basis.description: Human-readable explanation of why the procurement program was classified as stated.

applicable_regulations.description: List of applicable laws, regulations, or policy references. Each entry is a non-empty string.

known_facts.description: Established facts verified from source materials.

source.description: Source file_id and location where this fact was found.

status.description: Verification status: verified from source, assumed from context, or explicitly unverified.

unknown_items.description: Items explicitly marked as unknown or unverifiable.

description.description: What is unknown and why it could not be determined.

material_versions.description: Versions of source materials considered in this cycle.

version_label.description: Version identifier or label from the source document.

review_scope.description: Explicit description of what is and is not covered by this review.

assumptions.description: Working assumptions made during review, clearly separated from verified facts.

impact_if_wrong.description: What would change if this assumption is incorrect.

ProcurementProgram.description: Procurement program classification. Use 'unknown' when not determinable from available materials.
